name: webimg
description: Private image editor. Crop, resize, rotate, convert to WebP/AVIF/PNG/JPEG and compress, all on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https: http: data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
